# Cloud Functions that "Firebase backend release" may deploy to lvz-rooms, by
# name. It must match the exports of functions/index.js exactly (the guard
# checks). Change it only in a reviewed pull request: a name left off here
# could never be released, and a name on here is never deleted by CI.
memberSchedule
memberSubmitBooking
memberCancelBooking
memberEndBookingEarly
publicLobbySchedule
adminStartSession
adminEndSession
adminSchedule
adminBookingAction
adminNoteAction
